collision_energy.evidence: Proteome precursors were fragmented using HCD with 25% normalized collision energy (NCE), a precursor isolation width of 1.3 m/z and normalized AGC target of 200.
ADPr precursor isolation was performed at 1.3 m/z width, normalized AGC target of 400, and EThcD fragmented with NCE of 20.

enrichment_method.evidence: Peptides were incubated with GST-tagged Af1521 macrodomain beads (100 µL dry beads/10 mg sample, produced in-house using BL21(DE3) bacteria) in a head-over-tail mixer at 4°C for 3h.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were reconstituted in 50 mM Ammonium bicarbonate (ABC) and separated on an Acuity UPLC Peptide CSH C18 1.7 µm reversed-phase column under basic conditions, concatenation into 12 fractions (Batth and Olsen, 2016).
Peptides were purified and fractionated on stage tips at high pH into 2 fractions.
After loading samples for high pH fractionation, the flowthrough was collected and subjected to low pH stage tip purification.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Proteome samples were measured on Orbitrap Exploris 480 MS using HCD fragmentation.
ADPr samples were measured on Orbitrap Fusion Lumos™ Tribrid™ MS using EThcD fragmentation.
